units: CSS px in a 390 x 845 viewport; all PNGs are @2x

navbar.backdrop: frosted: backdrop-filter blur(18px) with a ~60% warm-white tint behind the navbar (the PNG is semi-transparent)

openTasksCarousel.note: Open Tasks row is a horizontal scroll in the Triveni prototype (overflow HORIZONTAL, extent 43px). Lay this strip over the same row in content.png and slide it; at swipeX 0 it matches content.png exactly.

steps.gesture: drag ring at y of the cards moving left by the same distance
drag ring at y of the cards moving left by the same distance

tap.style: soft ring: ink #2C2C2C, 12px radius at 22% opacity growing to 34px and fading out over 0.5s; inner fill 10%. 'press' = hold the ring for that many seconds before releasing

staticFallback: If not animating, render the resting frame (scrollY = restScrollY) with the callouts.
